python 3.11.15 (arm64, Darwin)
torch 2.13.0 (CPU-only usage; MPS never used)
numpy 2.4.6
pytest 9.1.1

Judge/agent process settings: torch.set_num_threads(2), OMP_NUM_THREADS=2,
torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), fp32, CPU device only.

Target deployment: python:3.11-slim container, 2 CPUs / 6 GB / no network
(see Dockerfile and DEPLOYMENT.md). The figures published in the repo are
measured natively on macOS/Apple Silicon with threads pinned to 2.
